memory.note: This page shows what you have added yourself. It does not scan any drives and finds nothing on its own. Use 'Add container…' to add a workspace, an area, a book or a bookshelf.
memory.empty: Nothing has been added yet. Use 'Add container…' to put the first container on the list — the most recently opened ones are suggested, and 'Choose folder…' reaches every other one.
memory.suggest.empty: There is nothing to suggest right now. Choose the folder of the container yourself.
memory.stats.partial: without index figures; open the area and collect again
memory.book.noShelf: not assigned to any bookshelf on the list
memory.exchange.note: Write your own settings to a file or read them back from a file.
memory.add.duplicate: This container is already on the list.
memory.add.unreachable: This folder is currently unreachable and was not added.
memory.removed: The entry has been removed. The container itself is unchanged.
memory.refreshed: The figures have been collected again.
memory.refreshFailed: The figures could not be collected. The container is currently unreadable.
memory.areaStats.otherWindow: The area was opened in another window. The area statistics are available there in the View menu.
memory.areaStats.failed: The area could not be opened.
